Toha

You were told not to.

I just wanted to tell you something.

Whatever mistakes you’ve made or things you regret, I hope you don’t think that’s the end of everything. Every sin you’ve committed isn’t the end of your story. It’s a part of life. You learn, you realise things, you do better and you move on. Don’t be too hard on yourself over everything.

And whatever happens, please don’t feel like you have to deal with everything alone. Just tell me about it. Literally whatever it is. I might judge you a little, but you know I won’t make you feel like you can’t talk to me. I’d rather you tell me than keep everything to yourself.

We’ve been friends for five years now, which is actually a long time when you think about it. We’ve had so many random hangouts, conversations and moments together. I’m glad I have someone like you in my life.

I also appreciate how much effort you put into things for me. You’re never miserly with your time or effort, and I notice that. I know I can trust you, and I hope you know you can trust me just as much.

Also, you’re really pretty. I don’t think I need to explain that one. Your eyes are genuinely so pretty.

Anyway, just remember that I’m here. Whatever happens, you can always come to me. You don’t have to figure everything out on your own.

That’s all. Don’t get too emotional about this.
